list._comment: WaitingScreen's contact list. No more centerOffsetY/maxHeight here (removed) — the list now fills the entire screen behind the settings icon/status strip (see #screenWaiting's own doc, styles.css, and WaitingScreen's Box, HomeScreens.kt). fadeHeightTop/fadeHeightBottom are now the same value on purpose (explicit request) — both edges fade over the same distance. Bottom is always one plain linear fade end to end; top is that same plain shape too whenever there's enough live-measured horizontal clearance from the settings icon, falling back to a split shape (an outer already-transparent half plus a compressed inner ramp) when there isn't — see .contact-list's own mask-image doc (styles.css) and fadingEdges' own doc (Theme.kt) for the full reasoning and the live measurement that picks between them.
